frame: 0-1 minimap frame, same as the atlas: origin top-left, u to the right, v down; positions are team-normalized, own spawn at the bottom (bottom-left on Okinawa). Shapes: circle (u, v, r), ellipse, polygon (points), cells (grid cell names plus centre u, v).
mode_rule: top6 = the share of Top 6 smokes (of that kind on that map) in the spot is clearly higher than the Rest share; otherwise shared.

fields.show: true = draw it on the map page; false = keep in the data only
fields.status: 'gold' (Top 6 spot, drawn as such), 'lead' (Top 6 by the interval rule but chosen for the gap: draw neutral), 'shared', or a 'hidden: ...' reason
fields.caught_per_100: deaths per 100 smokes on the batch smoke_deaths list ("caught"); track deaths ("died") are in the timeline block where present
fields.timeline: cap results from the cap timeline and both death metrics, for the records redone in round 5c item 7

changed_from_round5b: show, status and draw added to all 45 records. Three records are gold; six other Top 6 records are leads drawn neutral; the six danger zones and the two Loop high cells are hidden; c5-sf-early-d has no rates. deaths_per_100 renamed caught_per_100. cap_taken_n and cap_taken_pct (batch cap_won) removed; timeline values added for the five high cells and the Loop cap-sitter spot.
